text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haa! Haa! Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close, Ticket-zo!
But it was a fantastic race!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That was the greatest race everー!!
Let's do our best next time tooー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I blew it...
After making it all the way to the Derby, too...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm zo mad...!!
I'm zo maaaad!!"

The dream grand stage, the Nippon Derby,
slowly drew to a close.

On the day the Japan Derby came to an end,
I was heading home while comforting her
as she continued to cry.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... That refreshed me.
Thanks, Trainer."

She'd always been quick to cry, but...
I've never seen her look so heartbroken.
Just as I was wondering how best to encourage her—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...If it were those two... I'm sure they'd tell me:
'Stop crying all the time.'

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... After getting it all out with a good cry,
I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though I lost, all the fans
were still telling me I was awesome.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Winning isn't the only thing that matters.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Clashing with everything you've got...!
*That's* what makes an 'awesome race'!

Sniffling softly,
Winning Ticket gave a cheerful smile.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: In that sense, I think I was able to deliver a race that truly moved everyone!
choice_data_list: That was without a doubt the greatest race ever!
That was without a doubt the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiight, the next goal is the Kikuka Sho, right!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on the absolute best race there, too!
I'm gonna keep giving it my all--!!

Although her dream of winning the Derby didn't come true,
the satisfaction of having thrilled so many people
was clear in Winning Ticket's smile.
